visualCharacteristics.purpose: testimonials switched by person tabs, each panel showing an image and a quotation
visualCharacteristics.description: Interactive component: 4 tab buttons switch the panel. Quotations stay inside the tab panels; every tab label keeps its avatar, name and role, and each panel keeps its image.

contentPattern.structure: one row per testimonial: (1) tab label with avatar image, bold name and role; (2) panel with image, bold name, role and quotation paragraph
rows: Tab label: avatar image, name (strong), role
Tab content: image, name (strong), role, quotation paragraph

usage: Testimonial or quote carousels where people are selected from a row of avatar tabs.
reuseGuidance: Panels render above the tab list; keyboard arrows, Home and End move between tabs.
